label: batch-76
tail:
Batch 76 authoring is complete: **15 items** (12 on the A page and 3 examples), with frontmatter-only pages. I added two proved A-page prerequisites so the heavy-tail example can establish its normalizers, construct a probability law, and prove finite mean and infinite MGF.

The bandit claims were checked against [*Bandit Algorithms*](https://tor-lattimore.com/downloads/book/book.pdf) and the [Bubeck–Cesa-Bianchi monograph](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.5721). The new local lemmas use the full Cauchy-condensation proof in [Semmes](https://math.rice.edu/~semmes/math331.pdf) and the monotone-convergence proof in [Hunter’s notes](https://www.math.ucdavis.edu/~hunter/measure_theory/measure_notes_ch4.pdf).

**Checks passed:** strict contracts (15/15, 37 proof steps), precheck, proof layout (15 items, 0 defects), statement-first, content policy, focused dependency checks, and source-fetch verification (4/4). The batch-local dependency levels and page inventories also match.

**Owner reconciliation remains:** 4 items are ready and 11 are escalated because Batch 73 supplier readiness has not been authenticated. Their cross-batch rows remain open. The run is still held at `1-scaffold` by its existing owner repair blocker; the latest status showed 46/101 batches covered. The run-wide dependency check also reports empty scaffold inventories elsewhere, while Batch 76’s graph passes locally.

Per the no-overwrite rule, I preserved the heavy-tail example’s existing escalation. Its saved dependency list predates the new local prerequisites; the current dependencies and this limitation are recorded in the notes.
